levels.surface: سعد بن عبد الله بن أبي خلف
الحسن بن علي بن عبد الله بن المغيرة

notes: Three co-transmitters «جميعا» meet at Sa'd: they are one level; «أبي» is a bare relation
«قال سألت أبا جعفر (ع)»: the asker Muhammad b. Sulayman is a link, and the Imam asked is the last link as imam_in_text (owner ruling 2)
The question about the man on pilgrimage is the scene of the saying; the blessing «ع» is left out
